items.description: Report gives no concrete caller-provided deadline value or numeric hold threshold; the indefinite-hold effect is stated qualitatively with illustrative durations (1 hour, 1 day, 1 week, 1 month) and no comparator, so the temporal relation is carried as a grounded Boolean.

Report does not give a concrete caller-provided deadline value or the numeric relation between block.timestamp and that deadline; the deadline_enforced observable is a qualitative Boolean for later code binding.
